label: Indo-Pacific
method: Reef Check volunteer belt transects: four 20 m by 5 m segments per reef, indicator fish counted to 5 m above the line and expressed as individuals per 100 m². Regional means from 1,107 reef surveys worldwide, 1997 to 2001.
mpaContrast: Five of the ten indicator fish groups Reef Check tracked (grouper, snapper, parrotfish, bumphead parrotfish and sweetlips) were significantly more abundant inside marine protected areas than outside.
citation: Hodgson, G. and Liebeler, J. (2002). The Global Coral Reef Crisis: Trends and Solutions 1997 to 2001. Reef Check Foundation, Institute of the Environment, UCLA. 80 pp. ISBN 0-9723051-0-6.
